issues.description: The problem statement and template expect a no-argument Rideable.messageOnRide() that returns a String, and the template's Main calls r.messageOnRide() with no parameters. However, the solution defines Rideable.messageOnRide(int speed) (and Pig/Seal implement the version with an int parameter). This parameter mismatch will confuse students and lead to compilation/signature mismatches between the provided template usage and the solution implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) Change the solution to implement Rideable.messageOnRide() with no parameters and update Pig and Seal to return the no-arg string format "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]", or (B) Update the problem statement and template to specify a parameter (e.g. int speed) for messageOnRide() and adjust template Main calls accordingly. Prefer option (A) to match the current problem description and template usage.
